company.shortDescription: Layer By Layer is a California-based 3D printing technology start-up.
company.description: Layer By Layer sells 3D prints—not files, templates, or designs. They are a new kind of marketplace—the kind that wants to give you great 3D printable products without the all the hassle of downloading and slicing files on your computer. The kind that thinks designers should be rewarded for their work so that they can keep working. The kind that believes in a future where everyone uses 3D printers.
